candidates.name: Kettlebell Goblet Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Goblet Curl
Novice
1
Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis.
2
Raise the kettlebell bending your arms at the elbow until the kettlebell is level with your chest.
3
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
Beginner
1
Stand up straight with a kettlebell in one hand with your forearm facing out.
2
Raise the kettlebell, bending your arm at the elbow and keeping your forearm vertical until your palm faces the shoulder.
3
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Preacher Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Preacher Curl
Intermediate
1
Stand behind a bench, with your chest leaning over the edge of the bench.
2
With one arm resting on the bench, hold the kettlebell, bending the arm at the elbow.
3
Lower your arm using the bench as a guide, keeping your forearm straight.
4
Return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Concentration Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Concentration Curl
Intermediate
1
Sitting on a chair with your legs apart, rest your arm against your thigh and hold the kettlebell with your arm extended towards the floor.
2
Bending your arm at the elbow, lift the kettlebell until your palm faces your shoulder.
3
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same hand as the leg shifted backwards.
2
Bend forwards at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knee, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Rear Delt Row
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your upper chest and then lower the kettlebell- repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
2
Pick kettlebell from ground with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
3
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower kettlebell fully back to floor each rep.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
Beginner
1
Hinge at hips with back flat, holding kettlebell under shoulder.
2
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
3
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Drag Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Drag Curl
Beginner
1
Grab two kettlebells with an underhand grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight back and let the kettlebells drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
Novice
1
Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in one hand.
2
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
3
From this starting position, row the kettlebell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
4
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
2
Hold a kettlebell with palms facing down.
3
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a kettlebell in each hand.
2
Hinge at hips, keep back straight, and pull both kettlebells to hips.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
2
Hold kettlebell with palms facing down.
3
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row (Double)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Rear Delt Row (Double)
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell in each hand, hinge at hips.
2
Pull kettlebells while flaring your elbows, squeezing shoulder blades. Keep back flat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Gorilla Row
Intermediate
1
Stand with kettlebell between legs.
2
Hinge at hips, grab kettlebell, pull to chest and rotate at the torso
